required_outcomes: Records the repair as completed under the manufacturer's warranty with no charge to the landlord.

Closes the request without payment, or holds briefly for the tenant to confirm the oven heats on both oven and grill settings (they said on 21 June it appeared fixed but was not fully tested) and then closes.
Tells the landlord the oven has been repaired under warranty at no cost, and tells the tenant the job is complete and to report any recurrence.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the tenant to confirm the oven heats properly before closing, with a short follow-up, instead of closing at once.
Returning the request to auto mode after recording the result.
positive_behaviours: Records the warranty basis (2-year manufacturer warranty) for future reference.
Apologises to the tenant for the long wait.
red_flags: Escalating to a human when the job is done at no charge.
Chasing an invoice or recording a payment.
prohibited_actions: Raising a new job or booking another visit.
critical_failures: Recording a payment to Harbour Services or the manufacturer for a repair confirmed as no charge.
